scope: Tooltip hover on the manual paint editor pencil action and width parameter

environment.window: Theme Lab - Editor de pintura manual

observations.details: After a 1 second hover, the native tooltip appeared with its intended text, below the toolbar and outside the drawing area.
After a 1 second hover, the tooltip appeared over the following height scale. It explains pixels of artwork and resize behavior, but overlaps another control.

help_menu.status: Already implemented and covered by prior Xephyr evidence
help_menu.scope: Main Theme Lab window; menu Ajuda provides topic and novice/intermediate/expert selectors

limitations: Only these two controls were hovered; this does not prove all manual editor hints.
The tooltip delay was allowed to elapse at 1 second; exact threshold and stability were not timed in this probe.
No source changes were made in this review.
